name: PdxFieldList
description:
An array of objects in a form, one row per item: adding or removing a row re-indexes the fields,
and the values come back as an array.

members.name: name
members.description: Array field name in the form (e.g., 'items').

members.name: label
members.description: Optional label rendered above the list.

members.name: form
members.description: Form instance. If not provided, uses form context.

members.name: itemFields
members.description: Field definitions per array item. Builds one plain control per `type` — text, email, number, textarea, checkbox, switch (a `select` gets no options; anything else is a text input). A row that needs a component of its own, a picker or a select with options, goes in the `row` slot.

members.name: itemDefault
members.description: Default values for a new item.

members.name: addLabel
members.description: Label for the add button. Empty: the `field-list.add` component string ("+ Add" in English).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Array field name in the form (e.g., 'items').

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Optional label rendered above the list.

attributes.name: addlabel
attributes.description: Label for the add button. Empty: the `field-list.add` component string ("+ Add" in English).

slots.name: row
slots.description: Renders one row: a snippet `row(item, index, remove)` (`item` holds that row's values; `remove()` removes the row, for a row that draws its own button — the list also draws its remove button after the row's content).
slots.signature: (item: { [field: string]: unknown }, index: number, remove: () => void)

cssParts.name: header
cssParts.description: The line above the rows: the label and the add button.

cssParts.name: add
cssParts.description: An add button, in the header and in the footer.

cssParts.name: rows
cssParts.description: The box that holds the rows.

cssParts.name: cell
cssParts.description: One cell: a `pdx-form-field` around its control, or a summary in dialog mode.

cssParts.name: actions
cssParts.description: A row's buttons: edit (dialog mode) and remove.

cssParts.name: empty
cssParts.description: The message shown with no rows.

cssParts.name: footer
cssParts.description: The line under the rows, with its add button.

cssParts.name: dialog
cssParts.description: The dialog that edits one row, in dialog mode.
